Журнал изменений

(Ниже приведен перевод на английский язык, только для справки. Все условия и описания являются официальными в китайской версии. / The following is an English translation for reference. All terms and descriptions are subject to the Chinese version.)

🎨 English Description

Welcome to the project page for Soartex Fanver - Rebirth!

This is an unofficial ported edition of the classic 64x resolution resource pack Soartex Fanver, aiming to bring its unique, smooth, and modern art style to the latest versions of Minecraft.

✨ Core Info

  • Resolution: 64x

  • Status: Public Beta - Actively being updated and polished.

  • Maintainer: Lanluoluo

📖 Background
Soartex Fanver is the community continuation of the Soartex project founded by Soar49, known for its faithfulness to the original style and careful updates. After official updates paused, this ported edition (Rebirth) is maintained voluntarily by "Lanluoluo" to perform cross-version adaptation, ensuring players can continue to enjoy this classic visual experience in new game versions.

Author's original website

⚠️ Important Notes (Please Read Before Use)

  1. Unofficial Port: This is a community-driven porting project, not an official Soartex release.

  2. Beta Stage: Some textures may be placeholders. We will continuously replace and optimize them.

  3. Distribution Restriction: Redistribution of this pack on any other platform or file host is strictly prohibited. Official distribution channels are limited to this CurseForge page and the designated 3DM MOD站 page.

  4. Copyright: All original texture copyrights belong to the Soartex team. For all textures created or modified within this Rebirth edition, the distribution rights belong to the maintainer. It is strictly prohibited to copy, modify, or integrate the unique textures of this Rebirth edition into other projects without explicit authorization. (Refer to the previous communication case with the Soartex Grove project).

  5. Sustainability: Should the original project resume updates, this port may be discontinued.

🔧 Features of This Port

  • Continuous Updates: Follows official Minecraft releases, adapting new content and model formats.

  • Built-in Emissive Textures: Built-in light layers for ores, etc. (Requires CTM-supporting mods like OptiFine).

  • Model Optimizations: Added 3D models for some items (e.g., the Mace).

🙏 Credits & Community
Thanks to everyone who has contributed textures, provided technical help, or assisted with testing for the Soartex community. Maintaining a resource pack requires significant time and effort. Your support, constructive feedback, and respect for copyright are the driving forces behind this project.

We sincerely thank the following players for providing textures or technical support 🙏:

某个萌新，小俊，东逝水，我是橙子鹿  EscapeBacteia

 

Changelog

🎨 中文介绍 (Chinese Description)

欢迎来到 Soartex Fanver - Rebirth（舒服细致_重生）移植版项目页！

本项目是经典64x分辨率材质包 Soartex Fanver 的非官方延续移植版，旨在将这份独特的流畅现代艺术风格适配至最新的Minecraft版本。

✨ 核心信息

  • 分辨率：64x

  • 状态：公开测试版 - 正在积极更新与完善中

  • 维护者：蓝洛洛 (Lanluoluo)

📖 项目背景
Soartex Fanver 是 Soar49 创立的 Soartex 项目的社区延续版，以忠实于原版风格、审慎更新而闻名。在原版更新暂停后，本移植版（Rebirth）由维护者“蓝洛洛”自发承担起跨版本移植与适配工作，确保玩家能在新版本中继续享受这份经典的视觉体验。

作者原网

⚠️ 重要须知（使用前请务必阅读）

  1. 非官方移植：此为社区驱动的移植项目，并非Soartex官方发布。

  2. 测试阶段：部分纹理可能为占位符，我们将持续替换与优化。

  3. 分发限制：严禁在任何其他平台或网盘二次分发本移植包。官方发布渠道仅限本页面及3DM MOD站指定页面。

  4. 版权声明：所有原始纹理版权属于Soartex原团队。本移植版（Rebirth）中由维护者制作或修改的所有纹理，其后续发布权归属于维护者。严禁未经明确授权，对Rebirth版特有纹理进行复制、修改或整合至其他项目。（参见此前与 Soartex Grove 项目的沟通案例）

  5. 可持续发展：若原版恢复更新，本移植版将考虑终止。

🔧 移植版特色

  • 持续更新：紧跟Minecraft官方版本，适配新内容与新模型格式。

  • 内置发光效果：为矿石等纹理内置发光层（需支持CTM的模组如OptiFine）。

  • 模型优化：为部分物品（如重锤）添加了3D模型。

🙏 致谢与社区
感谢所有为Soartex社区贡献过纹理、提供过技术帮助与测试的朋友们。维护一个资源包需要大量时间与精力，您的每一份支持、反馈和尊重版权的行为，都是我们持续下去的动力。

衷心感谢以下玩家提供的纹理或技术支持🙏：

某个萌新，小俊，东逝水，我是橙子鹿  EscapeBacteia
